WoW: Forever

Holy Paladin

Plate-wearing single-target healer with party-wide Blessings and auras, and Forever gives it an area-healing answer through the new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3Cast1.5 sec castCost730 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownApplies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. Talents open at level 10. The one-point gold medal talents sit at 11, 21 and 31 points spent, joined in Forever by a new 16-point gold medal. Dual Specialization is bought from the class trainer at 40, for 50 gold by Wowhead's report.

Mechanics are Blizzard's where Blizzard has spoken: the October 15 Paladin deep dive, the November 2 development notes and the hotfixes through November 11. Numbers are the current client's, build 1.60.1.70938. A hover tooltip can lag a hotfix: where a tooltip and the prose differ, the prose is right.

The talent builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, published November 4 to 6 and replayed here against the current tree. Their stat lists were written before anyone had level-60 gear, and Wowhead calls its own speculative. No raid opens until December 9, 2026, so nothing here is measured in one.

Two kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning, not a source's. A client or guide-site reading is a number Blizzard has not published.

What Holy is for

Keeping a party standing while in plate, with the mana tools to keep doing it. Blizzard's own summary is that Holy sustains heals on a single target better than anything else in the game, that healing a whole party at once takes more planning, and that the new talents make Holy a viable healer across every form of group play. ReverenceReverenceTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps 30% of your Spirit-driven mana regeneration running while you cast. IlluminationIlluminationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantAfter getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell. refunds 50% of a spell's base cost when it procs.

The new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3Cast1.5 sec castCost730 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownApplies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 326 to 344. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party. capstone is the party-healing half of that. Mark an ally, and your next Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange20 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally. on them triggers no cooldown and heals their whole party. It is friendly-only: Blizzard removed its damage half in the November 2 notes.

Underneath all of that you are still a melee Paladin: keep a seal up and press Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. and JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. on cooldown. Blizzard made that easier to hold together. JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. no longer consumes your active Seal, and Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. trains at level 6 for 50% of your weapon damage plus a flat Holy bonus that grows with each rank, though the rank you actually train there reads 25% of weapon damage plus 12 Holy in the client, on a 10-second cooldown.

Dungeons are where a healer levels. Wowhead's levelling page says so outright: aim at dungeons and dungeon quests, ideally beside friends on damage specs, and expect solo questing to be slow. Dungeon quests reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values. Kills inside dungeons launched at 40% of their Classic Era experience and went to 60% on November 8.

Our own reading, not a sourced one: most of what Holy produces lands on other people, because the Blessings, auras and heals all apply to the party. The tree does buy damage, and that part is Blizzard's: Consecrated GroundConsecrated GroundTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration. raises Holy spell damage, Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 8%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by 20%. supplies its Hit, and the dive says Holy gains new tools for spell-focused damage.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then Intellect. Both sites open with those two. After that they differ. Icy Veins' level-60 list continues Spirit, MP5, critical strike. Wowhead's continues critical strike, then Spirit, and says its list is speculative because the beta stopped at 30. Icy Veins' levelling list puts MP5 and critical strike ahead of Spirit.

Spirit is worth more to Holy than to the other two specs because ReverenceReverenceTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps 30% of your mana regeneration running while you cast. Critical strike feeds IlluminationIlluminationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantAfter getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell. and Infusion of LightInfusion of LightTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantYour Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec., and both sites note most of it comes from Intellect, not from gear.

If you are not planning to heal seriously, gear Weapon Damage, Hit and critical strike early, then Spell Power, and play the Holy-damage path. Icy Veins gives that same early order for a levelling Holy Paladin.

Blizzard says it does not plan to itemize Hit chance on plate healing gear, and that Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 8%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by 20%. is there to supply it instead: up to 8% Hit with Holy spells and 20% shorter Silences, 2 points in row 4, with no Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange20 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally. requirement. On the Holy-damage path that talent is where your spell Hit comes from, not your gear.
